links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers to public health questions for lay readers (Flesch-Kincaid grade level, professional score)
links.effect: Most of the 25 LLMs evaluated failed to meet readability standards; no numeric values are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluation of 25 LLMs reveals that most fail to meet readability standards, highlighting a gap between reasoning and effective communication.

unlisted_practices: Training LLMs with readability-oriented reinforcement learning (GRPO and token-adapted GRPO) to improve plain-language output
Chain-of-thought and standard prompting to improve readability of LLM responses

screen.reason: The paper introduces a benchmark evaluating the readability of LLMs for consumer public health question answering and specifically tests prompting strategies and post-training alignment strategies to enforce readability constraints.
